title: Auto Drive, Auto Roll, Auto Build and Skills | No Key
features:
Full auto farm for Build and Kill Zombies. Open the panel, switch AUTO on, and it plays the whole loop: it drives your car down the road, rolls both machines, builds better parts into the car and spends the cash on skills.

FEATURES
- Auto drive with the game's own car physics at about 4x the car's speed (100 studs/s, a speed the server accepts)
- Drives straight through the rock piles and walls that stop cars (client side) - the record went from 2.68K to 3.23K studs and a run pays +2.2K cash instead of +1.5K
- Learns where the server corrects the speed and brakes there on the next runs
- Ends a run as soon as the car stalls - cash is paid live while driving, so nothing is lost
- Claims Loot Rain and Zeus event crates automatically
- Auto rolls both machines (rolls are free)
- Buys only parts that beat what the car already has, and holds a rare upgrade in the machine until you can afford it
- Builds better parts into the same cell of the car and mounts weapons into free weapon slots
- Auto skill tree: weapon slots, luck, golden and rainbow rolls, damage
- Auto redeem codes, quests and offline cash
- Anti-AFK: the game's own 15-minute idle rejoin is switched off

MOBILE
Works on PC and mobile - the panel asks once and scales itself, and it speaks English, German and Russian. Every setting survives a rejoin.

HOW TO RUN
1. Open Build and Kill Zombies
2. Paste the loader into your executor
3. Execute - the panel opens by itself
4. Press RightShift to show or hide it

Free and keyless. No Robux purchases are ever touched - Instant Buy, the Starter/Pro/Zeus packs and the offline tripler stay shut.
